gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Goldman spaces its letters wide, with round forms curving like open parentheses and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Noto Traditional Nushu answers softly, a broad-nibbed sans that fills its lines.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke cut flat at a single weight. Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curves generous, so text can stay small.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-devanagari: Almendra Display feels ornate and literary, never pinching its letters shut. It earns its keep big and brief, while Anek Devanagari brings open mouths and a tall middle zone for the text below.
gen-eater-gf-saira: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems and wide gaps between letters. Saira does the quieter job, its s clearly open and its rounded shapes reaching high toward the top line.
gen-flavors-gf-ruda: Ruda is a wire-like monoline sans with wide-mouthed rounds and a sizable x-height that holds up on a screen. Its steady, friendly build is what shines against Flavors, whose stubby, towering lowercase is pure whimsy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-savate: Savate has hairlines of reasonable sturdiness and open jaws on every curve. Autour One sits above it with expressive, bold strokes that never vary in weight, while Savate adds moderate shading in its round and straight strokes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sarpanch: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, so its thin-looking letters have no thinner parts at all. And Sarpanch is compact, with a clearly open lowercase e, so its body size can stay modest.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-numans: Wide, bold and full of swagger. Goldman is best at commanding attention with its parenthesis-round forms, whereas Numans does its work in modern, clean text, its s ends hanging far from the spine and its tracking loose.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya has wide, easy s turns and an oversized lowercase. Its best quality is how plainly it relaxes beside Audiowide, whose tile-like glyphs and pipe-cleaner-slim joins feel futuristic.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-gujarati: Ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut: that is Almendra Display. Anek Gujarati follows in a plain sans with a gaping c opening and lowercase rivaling its capitals, keeping the page clean and approachable.
